versos.hebraico: דִּ֭בְרֵי לְמוּאֵ֣ל מֶ֑לֶךְ מַ֝שָּׂ֗א אֲֽשֶׁר־יִסְּרַ֥תּוּ אִמּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: The words of king Lemuel; the oracle which his mother taught him.
controles.kjv: The words of king Lemuel, the prophecy that his mother taught him.
controles.livre: Palavras do rei Lemuel, a profecia que sua mãe o ensinava.

versos.hebraico: מַה־בְּ֭רִי וּמַֽה־בַּר־בִּטְנִ֑י וּ֝מֶה בַּר־נְדָרָֽי׃

controles.web: “Oh, my son! Oh, son of my womb! Oh, son of my vows!
controles.kjv: What, my son? and what, the son of my womb? and what, the son of my vows?
controles.livre: O que posso te dizer ,meu filho, ó filho do meu ventre? O que te direi ,filho de minhas promessas?

versos.hebraico: אַל־תִּתֵּ֣ן לַנָּשִׁ֣ים חֵילֶ֑ךָ וּ֝דְרָכֶ֗יךָ לַֽמְח֥וֹת מְלָכִֽין׃

controles.web: Don’t give your strength to women, nor your ways to that which destroys kings.
controles.kjv: Give not thy strength unto women, nor thy ways to that which destroyeth kings.
controles.livre: Não dês tua força às mulheres, nem teus caminhos para coisas que destroem reis.

versos.hebraico: אַ֤ל לַֽמְלָכִ֨ים׀ לְֽמוֹאֵ֗ל אַ֣ל לַֽמְלָכִ֣ים שְׁתוֹ־יָ֑יִן וּ֝לְרוֹזְנִ֗ים או שֵׁכָֽר׃

controles.web: It is not for kings, Lemuel; it is not for kings to drink wine; nor for princes to say, ‘Where is strong drink?’
controles.kjv: It is not for kings, O Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine; nor for princes strong drink:
controles.livre: Lemuel, não convém aos reis beber vinho; nem aos príncipes desejar bebida alcoólica.

versos.hebraico: פֶּן־יִ֭שְׁתֶּה וְיִשְׁכַּ֣ח מְחֻקָּ֑ק וִֽ֝ישַׁנֶּה דִּ֣ין כָּל־בְּנֵי־עֹֽנִי׃

controles.web: lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the justice due to anyone who is afflicted.
controles.kjv: Lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the judgment of any of the afflicted.
controles.livre: Para não acontecer de que bebam, e se esqueçam da lei, e pervertam o direito de todos os aflitos.

versos.hebraico: תְּנוּ־שֵׁכָ֣ר לְאוֹבֵ֑ד וְ֝יַיִן לְמָ֣רֵי נָֽפֶשׁ׃

controles.web: Give strong drink to him who is ready to perish; and wine to the bitter in soul:
controles.kjv: Give strong drink unto him that is ready to perish, and wine unto those that be of heavy hearts.
controles.livre: Dai bebida alcoólica aos que estão a ponto de morrer, e vinho que têm amargura na alma,

versos.hebraico: יִ֭שְׁתֶּה וְיִשְׁכַּ֣ח רִישׁ֑וֹ וַ֝עֲמָל֗וֹ לֹ֣א יִזְכָּר־עֽוֹד׃

controles.web: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.
controles.kjv: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.
controles.livre: Para que bebam, e se esqueçam de sua pobreza, e não se lembrem mais de sua miséria.

versos.hebraico: פְּתַח־פִּ֥יךָ לְאִלֵּ֑ם אֶל־דִּ֝֗ין כָּל־בְּנֵ֥י חֲלֽוֹף׃

controles.web: Open your mouth for the mute, in the cause of all who are left desolate.
controles.kjv: Open thy mouth for the dumb in the cause of all such as are appointed to destruction.
controles.livre: Abre tua boca no lugar do mudo pela causa judicial de todos os que estão morrendo.

versos.hebraico: פְּתַח־פִּ֥יךָ שְׁפָט־צֶ֑דֶק וְ֝דִ֗ין עָנִ֥י וְאֶבְיֽוֹן׃פ

controles.web: Open your mouth, judge righteously, and serve justice to the poor and needy.”
controles.kjv: Open thy mouth, judge righteously, and plead the cause of the poor and needy.
controles.livre: Abre tua boca, julga corretamente, e faze justiça aos oprimidos e necessitados.

versos.hebraico: אֵֽשֶׁת־חַ֭יִל מִ֣י יִמְצָ֑א וְרָחֹ֖ק מִפְּנִינִ֣ים מִכְרָֽהּ׃

controles.web: Who can find a worthy woman? For her price is far above rubies.
controles.kjv: Who can find a virtuous woman? for her price is far above rubies.
controles.livre: Mulher virtuosa, quem a encontrará? Pois seu valor é muito maior que o de rubis.

versos.hebraico: בָּ֣טַח בָּ֭הּ לֵ֣ב בַּעְלָ֑הּ וְ֝שָׁלָ֗ל לֹ֣א יֶחְסָֽר׃

controles.web: The heart of her husband trusts in her. He shall have no lack of gain.
controles.kjv: The heart of her husband doth safely trust in her, so that he shall have no need of spoil.
controles.livre: O coração de seu marido confia nela, e ele não terá falta de bens.

versos.hebraico: גְּמָלַ֣תְהוּ ט֣וֹב וְלֹא־רָ֑ע כֹּ֝֗ל יְמֵ֣י חַיֶּֽיה׃

controles.web: She does him good, and not harm, all the days of her life.
controles.kjv: She will do him good and not evil all the days of her life.
controles.livre: Ela lhe faz bem, e não o mal, todos os dias de sua vida.

versos.hebraico: דָּ֭רְשָׁה צֶ֣מֶר וּפִשְׁתִּ֑ים וַ֝תַּ֗עַשׂ בְּחֵ֣פֶץ כַּפֶּֽיהָ׃

controles.web: She seeks wool and flax, and works eagerly with her hands.
controles.kjv: She seeketh wool, and flax, and worketh willingly with her hands.
controles.livre: Ela busca lã e linho, e com prazer trabalha com suas mãos.

versos.hebraico: הָ֭יְתָה כָּאֳנִיּ֣וֹת סוֹחֵ֑ר מִ֝מֶּרְחָ֗ק תָּבִ֥יא לַחְמָֽהּ׃

controles.web: She is like the merchant ships. She brings her bread from afar.
controles.kjv: She is like the merchants’ ships; she bringeth her food from afar.
controles.livre: Ela é como um navio mercante; de longe traz a sua comida.

versos.hebraico: וַתָּ֤קָם׀ בְּע֬וֹד לַ֗יְלָה וַתִּתֵּ֣ן טֶ֣רֶף לְבֵיתָ֑הּ וְ֝חֹ֗ק לְנַעֲרֹתֶֽיהָ׃

controles.web: She rises also while it is yet night, gives food to her household, and portions for her servant girls.
controles.kjv: She riseth also while it is yet night, and giveth meat to her household, and a portion to her maidens.
controles.livre: Ainda de noite ela se levanta, e dá alimento a sua casa; e ordens às suas servas.

versos.hebraico: זָמְמָ֣ה שָׂ֭דֶה וַתִּקָּחֵ֑הוּ מִפְּרִ֥י כַ֝פֶּ֗יהָ נטע כָּֽרֶם׃

controles.web: She considers a field, and buys it. With the fruit of her hands, she plants a vineyard.
controles.kjv: She considereth a field, and buyeth it: with the fruit of her hands she planteth a vineyard.
controles.livre: Ela avalia um campo, e o compra; do fruto de suas mãos planta uma vinha.

versos.hebraico: חָֽגְרָ֣ה בְע֣וֹז מָתְנֶ֑יהָ וַ֝תְּאַמֵּ֗ץ זְרֹעוֹתֶֽיהָ׃

controles.web: She arms her waist with strength, and makes her arms strong.
controles.kjv: She girdeth her loins with strength, and strengtheneth her arms.
controles.livre: Ela prepara seus lombos com vigor, e fortalece seus braços.

versos.hebraico: טָ֭עֲמָה כִּי־ט֣וֹב סַחְרָ֑הּ לֹֽא־יִכְבֶּ֖ה בליל נֵרָֽהּ׃

controles.web: She perceives that her merchandise is profitable. Her lamp doesn’t go out by night.
controles.kjv: She perceiveth that her merchandise is good: her candle goeth not out by night.
controles.livre: Ela prova que suas mercadorias são boas, e sua lâmpada não se apaga de noite.

versos.hebraico: יָ֭דֶיהָ שִׁלְּחָ֣ה בַכִּישׁ֑וֹר וְ֝כַפֶּ֗יהָ תָּ֣מְכוּ פָֽלֶךְ׃

controles.web: She lays her hands to the distaff, and her hands hold the spindle.
controles.kjv: She layeth her hands to the spindle, and her hands hold the distaff.
controles.livre: Ela estende suas mãos ao rolo de linha, e com suas mãos prepara os fios.

versos.hebraico: כַּ֭פָּהּ פָּרְשָׂ֣ה לֶעָנִ֑י וְ֝יָדֶ֗יהָ שִׁלְּחָ֥ה לָֽאֶבְיֽוֹן׃

controles.web: She opens her arms to the poor; yes, she extends her hands to the needy.
controles.kjv: She stretcheth out her hand to the poor; yea, she reacheth forth her hands to the needy.
controles.livre: Ela estende sua mão ao aflito, e estica os braços aos necessitados.

versos.hebraico: לֹא־תִירָ֣א לְבֵיתָ֣הּ מִשָּׁ֑לֶג כִּ֥י כָל־בֵּ֝יתָ֗הּ לָבֻ֥שׁ שָׁנִֽים׃

controles.web: She is not afraid of the snow for her household; for all her household are clothed with scarlet.
controles.kjv: She is not afraid of the snow for her household: for all her household are clothed with scarlet.
controles.livre: Ela não terá medo da neve por sua casa, pois todos os de sua casa estão agasalhados.

versos.hebraico: מַרְבַדִּ֥ים עָֽשְׂתָה־לָּ֑הּ שֵׁ֖שׁ וְאַרְגָּמָ֣ן לְבוּשָֽׁהּ׃

controles.web: She makes for herself carpets of tapestry. Her clothing is fine linen and purple.
controles.kjv: She maketh herself coverings of tapestry; her clothing is silk and purple.
controles.livre: Ela faz cobertas para sua cama; de linho fino e de púrpura é o seu vestido.

versos.hebraico: נוֹדָ֣ע בַּשְּׁעָרִ֣ים בַּעְלָ֑הּ בְּ֝שִׁבְתּ֗וֹ עִם־זִקְנֵי־אָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: Her husband is respected in the gates, when he sits among the elders of the land.
controles.kjv: Her husband is known in the gates, when he sitteth among the elders of the land.
controles.livre: Seu marido é famoso às portas da cidade ,quando ele se senta com os anciãos da terra.

versos.hebraico: סָדִ֣ין עָ֭שְׂתָה וַתִּמְכֹּ֑ר וַ֝חֲג֗וֹר נָתְנָ֥ה לַֽכְּנַעֲנִֽי׃

controles.web: She makes linen garments and sells them, and delivers sashes to the merchant.
controles.kjv: She maketh fine linen, and selleth it; and delivereth girdles unto the merchant.
controles.livre: Ela faz panos de linho fino, e os vende; e fornece cintos aos comerciantes.

versos.hebraico: עֹז־וְהָדָ֥ר לְבוּשָׁ֑הּ וַ֝תִּשְׂחַ֗ק לְי֣וֹם אַחֲרֽוֹן׃

controles.web: Strength and dignity are her clothing. She laughs at the time to come.
controles.kjv: Strength and honour are her clothing; and she shall rejoice in time to come.
controles.livre: Força e glória são suas roupas, e ela sorri pelo seu futuro.

versos.hebraico: פִּ֭יהָ פָּתְחָ֣ה בְחָכְמָ֑ה וְתֽוֹרַת־חֶ֝֗סֶד עַל־לְשׁוֹנָֽהּ׃

controles.web: She opens her mouth with wisdom. Faithful instruction is on her tongue.
controles.kjv: She openeth her mouth with wisdom; and in her tongue is the law of kindness.
controles.livre: Ela abre sua boca com sabedoria; e o ensinamento bondoso está em sua língua.

versos.hebraico: צ֭וֹפִיָּה הֲלִיכ֣וֹת בֵּיתָ֑הּ וְלֶ֥חֶם עַ֝צְל֗וּת לֹ֣א תֹאכֵֽל׃

controles.web: She looks well to the ways of her household, and doesn’t eat the bread of idleness.
controles.kjv: She looketh well to the ways of her household, and eateth not the bread of idleness.
controles.livre: Ela presta atenção aos rumos de sua casa, e não come pão da preguiça.

versos.hebraico: קָ֣מוּ בָ֭נֶיהָ וַֽיְאַשְּׁר֑וּהָ בַּ֝עְלָ֗הּ וַֽיְהַֽלְלָהּ׃

controles.web: Her children rise up and call her blessed. Her husband also praises her:
controles.kjv: Her children arise up, and call her blessed; her husband also, and he praiseth her.
controles.livre: Seus filhos se levantam e a chamam de bem-aventurada; seu marido também a elogia, dizendo :

versos.hebraico: רַבּ֣וֹת בָּ֭נוֹת עָ֣שׂוּ חָ֑יִל וְ֝אַ֗תְּ עָלִ֥ית עַל־כֻּלָּֽנָה׃

controles.web: “Many women do noble things, but you excel them all.”
controles.kjv: Many daughters have done virtuously, but thou excellest them all.
controles.livre: Muitas mulheres agem com virtude, mas tu és melhor que todas elas.

versos.hebraico: שֶׁ֣קֶר הַ֭חֵן וְהֶ֣בֶל הַיֹּ֑פִי אִשָּׁ֥ה יִרְאַת־יְ֝הוָ֗ה הִ֣יא תִתְהַלָּֽל׃

controles.web: Charm is deceitful, and beauty is vain; but a woman who fears Yahweh, she shall be praised.
controles.kjv: Favour is deceitful, and beauty is vain: but a woman that feareth the Lord, she shall be praised.
controles.livre: A beleza é enganosa, e a formosura é passageira; mas a mulher que teme ao SENHOR, essa será louvada.

versos.hebraico: תְּנוּ־לָ֭הּ מִפְּרִ֣י יָדֶ֑יהָ וִֽיהַלְל֖וּהָ בַשְּׁעָרִ֣ים מַעֲשֶֽׂיהָ׃

controles.web: Give her of the fruit of her hands! Let her works praise her in the gates!
controles.kjv: Give her of the fruit of her hands; and let her own works praise her in the gates.
controles.livre: Dai a ela conforme o fruto de suas mãos, e que suas obras a louvem às portas da cidade .
